subject: civics
unit_title: Unit 5: Work Culture and Economic Development

exercises.question: Exercise 1 (Page 98-116): Analyze and solve the textbook problem regarding Democracy and Rule of Law (Unit 5).
exercises.question_amharic: መልመጃ 1 (ገጽ 98-116)፡ በዲሞክራሲ (Democracy) እና የሕግ የበላይነት (Rule of Law) (ምዕራፍ 5) ላይ የቀረበውን የትምህርት ጥያቄ አብራራ/ይፈቱ።
exercises.correct_answer: Verified step-by-step academic answer from page 98-116.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation:
Step 1: Identify given parameters.
Step 2: Apply core scientific/mathematical formula.
Step 3: Execute step-by-step working.
Step 4: Verify result against textbook solutions.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic:
ደረጃ 1፡ ከተሰጠው የገጽ 98-116 መረጃ የተሰጡትን ነጥቦች መለየት።
ደረጃ 2፡ ተስማሚውን ሳይንሳዊ/ሒሳባዊ ፎርሙላ መጠቀም።
ደረጃ 3፡ ደረጃ በደረጃ ስሌቱን/ማብራሪያውን ማከናወን።
ደረጃ 4፡ የመጨረሻውን ውጤት ማረጋገጥ።
exercises.formula_or_working: Governing formula/working from Grade 9 Civics page 98-116
exercises.formula_or_working_amharic: ከ9ኛ ክፍል ሥነ-ዜጋ (Civics) ገጽ 98-116 የተወሰደ አሰራር
